## Description
 &#10;&#9;&#9;A 1m x 1m sheet with 5 mm (3/8 inch) thick is 4.78 kg each.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;The general chain is: &#10;&#9;&#9;fossil feedstock → cracking → monomers → polymerization → resin pellets → extrusion/casting → sheet.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;The resin is melted and pushed through a flat die (calender or extrusion line), then cooled and cut to size&#10;&#10;&#9;&#9;
